rain.name: Rain alerts
rain.description: MET Malaysia thunderstorm and heavy rain warnings for your state, as an alert on the notch.
rain.privacy: Fetches the list of all current warnings from api.data.gov.my every 20 minutes. Your state is never sent: the list is filtered on this PC.
rain.needsArea: Pick your area on the Prayer times page in Settings.
